description:
The property welcomes you into a generous entrance hall, where two sizeable storage cupboards provide an abundance of practical space –a highly valuable feature in apartment living. The bright and spacious living/dining room offers plenty of room for both comfortable seating and a dining set, making it an ideal space for relaxing or entertaining.

Unlike many modern apartments, the kitchen is separate from the main living area, creating a practical layout for everyday living. It is well appointed with a range of modern units, integrated appliances and the added benefit of a useful pantry cupboard, providing further storage.

There are two well-proportioned double bedrooms, both offering comfortable accommodation with space for additional furniture. The contemporary bathroom is finished to a modern standard and serves the property well.

Outside, residents benefit from on-street parking.

Highdene Road is located off Fulbourn Old Drift, close to the heart of Cherry Hinton to the South East of Cambridge and benefits from many local facilities. As a self-contained village there are a wide range of shops and services, primary and nursery schooling, a library and the nearby Cherry Hinton Hall. Access is also convenient to Addenbrookes Hospital, the A10 and A14 with a regular bus service to the City Centre. An established Tesco Superstore is a short distance away.
